look_here_first: The mat-forming Sida: long flexible procumbent stems, small crenate leaves, and small pale yellowish flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays and Travis remain supported target-zone occurrences. The older Williamson record is outside the project target zone, so native certification remains unresolved while learner admission stays approved.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Do not count as confirmed target-zone native until a third valid project county is documented.
